name.description: Human-readable list name, e.g. "2026 AI Terms". Always a plain string; localized variants go in `nameLocalized`.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this JSON Schema the document conforms to. Currently 1.

nameLocalized.description: Optional map of BCP-47 language tag to localized list name. Selection walks the reader's preferred languages and matches by progressive truncation, falling back to `name` (see FORMAT.md §3b).

languages.description: BCP-47 tags naming the languages this list applies to, e.g. ["en-US"] or ["en-US", "en-GB"]. A list may declare several. Omitting the field means unknown, never English (see FORMAT.md §3b).

version.description: Content-level version stamp, set by the deploy pipeline. Free-form but conventionally YYYY-MM-DD or a semver-like string; used as the change signal once a fetch returns new content.

last_modified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last publish that changed this artifact.

refreshUrl.description: Canonical HTTPS URL this list is refreshed from. Takes precedence over the URL the file was fetched from (see FORMAT.md §7c). Present on official and republished lists; absent on one-off hand-authored files with no live source.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or short license name covering this list's content, e.g. "CC0-1.0".

sourceUrl.description: Imported snapshots only: where this snapshot was read from. Stamped by the importing client, absent on published artifacts.

importedAt.description: Imported snapshots only: when this snapshot was taken.

sourceVersion.description: Imported snapshots only: the source list's `_meta_.version` at import time, if it had one. Used to detect whether a re-fetch found something newer.

includes.description: Ordered references to other lists. Index 0 is highest precedence (see FORMAT.md §5).

ref.description: RFC 3986 URI reference naming the list to include: a relative path resolved against this file's own base (FORMAT.md §5), or an absolute HTTPS URL.
